work_items.title: Migrate repository governance to Palari Company OS
work_items.scope: Archive old Palari Orchestrator artifacts, install the new Company OS CLI and workspace, map useful docs as sources, and verify the app still passes existing checks.
work_items.acceptance_target: Founder can continue work with Company OS commands and can find the archived Orchestrator history.
verification_expectations: ./bin/company-os scope WORK-MIGRATION-0001 for changed migration paths

work_items.title: Premium Android visual system redesign
work_items.scope: Implement the premium Android visual system from docs/product/premium-visual-goal, starting with a lighter first screen and multi-user clarity while preserving content.
forbidden_actions: use paid design APIs without human approval
work_items.acceptance_target: Founder says the app direction feels premium enough to proceed toward internal testing.

work_items.title: Local-first user and group account model
work_items.scope: Introduce SQL-ready local entities for users, group_members, expense_participants, activity_events, and sync_outbox while preserving the current local-first UI behavior.
work_items.acceptance_target: Local demo accounts and group participation model are clear and replaceable by future auth/sync adapters.

work_items.title: Android internal testing readiness
work_items.scope: Prepare the app, docs, assets, and checklist needed to be very close to a Play Store internal testing upload without secrets, signing keys, or production submission. Evidence reports may be written under reports/evidence for this work item.
work_items.acceptance_target: Founder has a concrete internal testing checklist and all local assets/docs are ready for credential-backed release work.

work_items.title: Premium add-expense participant flow
work_items.scope: Redesign and implement the add-expense flow so it feels premium, light, Android-first, and multi-user: active identity, payer, participant selection, equal MXN split preview, no-real-payments cue, keyboard-safe sheet behavior, and clear empty/error states. No real payments, backend services, secrets, or production deployment.
work_items.acceptance_target: Add-expense flow lets a user choose payer and participants, previews equal MXN shares, preserves selected participant IDs in local data, and passes visual/code checks.

work_items.title: Premium account and local data controls
work_items.scope: Expose account/settings local data controls for the premium MVP: clear local account state, reset demo/local data, show what local data exists, and reinforce no backend/no remote deletion. Use only local adapters and docs; no production auth, backend, legal approval, secrets, or payments.
work_items.acceptance_target: Perfil provides clear local-only account/data controls with safe confirmation, local deletion/reset behavior, Spanish copy, tests/docs/evidence, and no production service claims.

work_items.title: Premium activity history and audit trail
work_items.scope: Polish activity/history so it uses the SQL-ready activity_events model, shows actor identity, group/member/expense/settlement events, local/demo trust cues, and a lighter audit-trail UI. No backend sync, payments, secrets, push, or production services.
work_items.acceptance_target: Activity tab and balance preview show a professional local audit trail with actor names, event types, MXN amounts where relevant, and no-real-payments cues for settlements.

work_items.title: Record actions with active local identity
work_items.scope: Align money-affecting local actions with the active group identity: expenses and settlement records should use the active group member userId as actor/creator where available, so activity audit rows show the person currently acting. No production auth, backend sync, secrets, payments, or external services.
work_items.acceptance_target: Adding expenses and marking settlements locally records createdByUserId/recordedByUserId and activity actor from the active group member identity, with fallback to selected demo user.

work_items.title: Premium settlement clarity and local confirmation
work_items.scope: Polish settlement suggestions and confirmation so users can immediately understand who pays whom, whether the action involves the active identity, MXN amount, and that marking paid is only a local record outside the app. No real payments, backend services, secrets, paid APIs, push, or Play Store submission.
work_items.acceptance_target: Settlement rows and confirmation use personal Spanish copy, clear payer/receiver structure, MXN amount, no-real-payments cues, and local-only action language without removing existing content.

work_items.title: Premium first-viewport visual density pass
work_items.scope: Reduce visual weight and improve premium Android first-viewport clarity without removing required content: active identity, group, personal balance, next action, settlement cue, MXN, and Sin pagos reales must remain visible on 360x740, 390x844, and 412x915. Use code-only GLM 5.2 review for design planning. No real payments, backend services, secrets, paid APIs, push, or Play Store submission.
work_items.acceptance_target: First viewport feels lighter, more professional, and closer to the premium goal while preserving core content and passing Android-size screenshot checks.

work_items.title: Premium color system refinement
work_items.scope: Replace the current app palette with a more premium Android-first Mexico/LATAM fintech color selection that feels cleaner, less harsh, and more professional while preserving contrast, MXN trust cues, settlement risk cues, and no-real-payments boundaries. No layout overhaul, real payments, backend services, secrets, paid APIs, push, or Play Store submission.
work_items.acceptance_target: Theme tokens, design-system note, screenshots, and GLM 5.2 code-only review show a better premium palette with accessible contrast and no one-note color dominance.

work_items.title: Visual comprehension and motion layer
work_items.scope: Add tasteful Android-first visual objects and lightweight animations so the app is easier to understand without relying mostly on text: animated balance/settlement route cues, clearer money-flow figures, and visual anchors for activity. Preserve content, accessibility, local/no-real-payments boundaries, and performance. No real payments, backend services, secrets, paid APIs, push, or Play Store submission.
work_items.acceptance_target: First viewport and balance/activity surfaces include meaningful animated/visual comprehension cues, pass checks, and remain readable on Android viewport screenshots.

work_items.title: Object-led Splitwise interaction pass
work_items.scope: Recycle the useful toy-app interaction patterns into Cuentas Claras: restrained group identity icons, avatar stacks, category chips, amount-first add-expense flow, settlement route visuals, date-sectioned activity, and richer empty states while preserving the premium local-only no-real-payments model.
work_items.acceptance_target: Cuentas Claras feels more visual, easier to understand, and closer to a premium Android shared-expense app without becoming toy-like.

work_items.title: Repair add-expense dropdown selectors
work_items.scope: Replace the broken add-expense category, payer, and participant card grids with compact animated dropdown/list selectors; expand the category taxonomy; keep local-first MXN and no-real-payments behavior unchanged.
work_items.acceptance_target: The add-expense sheet is readable on narrow Android widths, categories are richer, and category/payer/participant choices use polished dropdown list menus instead of large cards.

decisions.question: How should old Palari Orchestrator artifacts be handled during the Company OS migration?
decisions.context: The repository had an old tracked Orchestrator workflow plus many local .palari worktrees. The migration needed to preserve useful records while preventing new work from continuing in the old CUE system.
options: Archive old workflow files inside docs/legacy and install Company OS alongside the app
tradeoffs: Deleting would be clean but could lose evidence and branch recovery context
Keeping both active would preserve everything but keep the slow workflow alive
Archiving preserves history while making the forward workflow clear
decisions.recommendation: Archive old workflow files inside docs/legacy, leave local .palari worktrees untouched, and make Company OS the forward workflow.
decisions.result: Archive old workflow files inside docs/legacy, leave local .palari worktrees untouched, and make Company OS the forward workflow.

decisions.question: What product direction should future Company OS work optimize for?
decisions.context: The founder said the current app still feels ugly and wants a cleaner, more professional Android-first experience.
options: Continue the old heavy MVP visual direction
Restart toward a lighter premium Android finance app with Stripe-like clarity and LATAM warmth
tradeoffs: Continuing the old direction is faster but preserves the perceived heaviness
Restarting the visual system takes more work but better matches the desired premium product bar
decisions.recommendation: Restart toward a lighter premium Android finance app with Stripe-like clarity and LATAM warmth.
decisions.safe_default: Do visual redesign work locally with no payments or production integrations.
decisions.result: Restart toward a lighter premium Android finance app with Stripe-like clarity and LATAM warmth.
